text.en:
There is hereby established in the City of Pagadian a school of arts and trades to be known as the
Zamboanga del Sur School of Arts and Trades. The curricular offerings of said school shall be determined by
the Minister of Education and Culture.

The Minister of Education and Culture shall implement the provisions of this Act so as to make
said Zamboanga del Sur School of Arts and Trades in operation during the first school term following the
approval of this Act.

The amount of three hundred thousand pesos for the operation of the school shall be charged to
the appropriations authorized by Batas Pambansa Blg. 80 for the Ministry of Education and Culture intended
for new national schools. Starting Calendar Year 1983 such sum as may be necessary for the operation and
maintenance of the school shall be provided in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: February 8, 1982
